package.name: echo_chamber
package.description: This is my first ros2 package. It includes some practice programs which helped me understant how ros2 works. I learnt the basic setting up of a node and communication between 2 nodes. draw_circle, is an example publisher code which uses turtulesim to draw a circle. first_node is my first node which just prints info. pose_subscriber is an example subscriber node which recieves info from turtlesim. The main assignment was to create a publisher node which publishes a random float and a subscriber which recieves the float and prints it and also prints its second multiple. talker is the publisher and listener is the subscriber. It uses the Float 32 format to transmit data. I enjoyed this first assignment and am looking forward for the next one
